items.title: NTT DATA Launches AI-Driven HR Transformation with SAP Integration
items.summary: Discover how NTT DATA is revolutionizing human resources with AI-driven solutions integrated with SAP, enhancing efficiency and transforming workforce management.

items.title: Nvidia launches free tool that links idle computers into a personal AI data center
items.summary: Nvidia is announcing its new Personal AI Router (PAIR), a free tool that syncs up your home computers for tackling local AI inference tasks with tools like Ollama and LM Studio.
items.whyItMatters: A tool you could evaluate without a procurement process — the question is whether it removes a task you currently do by hand.
actions: Check whether the free tier covers your actual volume before paying for the equivalent elsewhere.
Free to run, but budget the setup time honestly before committing.

items.title: Anthropic Joins AI Price War With Release of Fable 5.1
items.summary: The vendor reduced cache read pricing for Fable 5.1 and said the model is similar to Mythos 5.1, with different safeguards.
items.whyItMatters: This moves your cost base. Even small per-seat changes compound when you are paying out of revenue rather than a budget line.
actions: Compare against what you currently pay for the same job and reprice if the gap is material.

items.title: Ollie is betting its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
items.summary: The family-focused AI assistant wants access to the details of your everyday life, but says it won’t use that data to train AI models or share it with others.
items.whyItMatters: An obligation, not an opportunity. Small businesses get caught out here because nobody is watching the rules full time.
actions: Check what customer data you are currently passing to AI tools, and under what terms.
